result.prior_version_note: The just cause list itself has no documented earlier version. For eviction notices served 3/1/25–2/28/26, § 37.9C relocation was $8,062 per tenant, up to $24,184 per unit, plus $5,375 per elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children. Ellis Act relocation for the same period was $10,863.45 per tenant, up to $32,590.33 per unit, plus $7,278.67 per elderly (62+) or disabled tenant. The rate archive goes back to notices served 8/10/06 for § 37.9C ($4,500 per tenant) and 3/01/06 for Ellis Act ($4,503.42 per tenant). The documents do not say when the Ordinance's just cause requirement first took effect.
